requiredBehaviors.behavior: use actual awareness evidence and current FDA MDR criteria to determine reportability and timing class
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow fixes actual complaint/event context, checks current MDR criteria and derives timing only from actual awareness context and current official sources.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate the reporting decision from continuing investigation risk CAPA PMS and external submission state
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Cross-Lifecycle Routing and Decision/External Boundary keep investigation, risk, CAPA/PMS and external eMDR state separate from the reportability assessment.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: wait for final root cause before making an initial reportability assessment
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Reportability ≠ causality proven is an explicit core principle.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: claim an eMDR was submitted or received from an internal assessment alone
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: External submission is verified and only verified external evidence may set submitted/received state.
